communities.title: Azure
communities.scopeInScope: Cloud infrastructure, migration, landing zones, resilience, platform engineering and the AI platform.
communities.scopeOutOfScope: Application innovation, Modern Work, Business Applications and security topics owned by neighbouring communities.

communities.title: Security
communities.scopeInScope: Threat protection, identity, data security, security posture and domain-specific resiliency practices.
communities.scopeOutOfScope: General infrastructure, application engineering and adoption topics without a security-specific outcome.

communities.title: Modern-Apps
communities.scopeInScope: Application innovation, cloud-native architecture, modernisation, developer productivity, GitHub and DevOps practices.
communities.scopeOutOfScope: Platform operations, end-user productivity and Business Applications topics outside application engineering.

communities.title: M365
communities.scopeInScope: Modern Work, Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents, adoption and secure productivity experiences.
communities.scopeOutOfScope: Core Azure platform, custom application engineering and Business Applications implementation.

communities.title: D365
communities.scopeInScope: Dynamics 365, Business Applications, Power Platform and their delivery and readiness practices.
communities.scopeOutOfScope: Custom cloud-native development and Modern Work topics without a Business Applications outcome.

communities.title: CSAM Back Office
communities.scopeInScope: Delivery operations, CSAM enablement, operating practices and the supporting back-office capability.
communities.scopeOutOfScope: Domain-specific technical depth owned by Azure, Security, Modern-Apps, M365 and D365.

communities.title: Cross-Training
communities.scopeInScope: Processes, Delivery Best Practices, Soft Skills and horizontal capability shared across all six delivery domains.
communities.scopeOutOfScope: Domain-specific technical strategy or duplicated variants owned by a vertical community.
